clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most vitamin C on a shelf isn't vitamin C - it's ascorbic acid, a lab-made piece of it. Scurvy is a vitamin C deficiency: a pile of ascorbic acid won't clear it. An orange will, because it carries bioflavonoids no pill has bottled.

That's why he says he went to the farm himself when he built his own supplements: tested the soil, asked who picked the fruit, traced every seed. People called him insane for doing it the hard way instead of buying cheap ascorbic acid.

Next time you flip a bottle over, look for the word "ascorbic." What is your vitamin C actually missing?
